name: Bad Influence
overview: Scripture warns believers to avoid bad influences that lead them away from righteousness, as seen in Psalms 1:1, which blesses those who shun the counsel of the ungodly and sinners. Proverbs emphasizes the danger of close association with fools and the angry, illustrating that such companionship can bring destruction and harm, like fire burning one's clothes (Proverbs 6:27; 13:20; 22:24). Jesus calls His followers to be the salt of the earth, maintaining their distinctiveness and purity, and to remove anything that causes them to stumble, even at great personal cost (Matthew 5:13; 18:9). Together, these verses teach the necessity of guarding one's heart and relationships to preserve spiritual life and witness.
